blocks.value: The Thread class provides methods for managing a thread's lifecycle and identity:

Method        Description
start         starts the thread by calling its run() method
run           the code the thread actually executes
setName       sets the thread's name
getName       gets the thread's name
setPriority   sets the thread's priority
getPriority   gets the thread's priority
isAlive       checks whether the thread is still running
join          waits for the thread to finish
sleep         pauses the thread for a set amount of time

Thread priority is a number the scheduler considers when deciding which threads to run. Valid values range from MIN_PRIORITY (1) to MAX_PRIORITY (10); NORM_PRIORITY (5) is the default. A higher priority doesn't guarantee a thread runs first or more often, it just gives it a better chance at CPU time.
Thread.currentThread() gives you a reference to whichever thread is executing that line of code, which is how run() can print its own thread's name.
